R33 not confirmed staged or live. Stromation main 7b9874f unchanged; designer runtime #359 and skill #57 are open, not implemented. Latest paid ATSHack site scored 6/10 and blind homepage ~5.5/10; no independently accepted 8+/10 live Fargate site, verified $1 checkout/forms, three owner handoffs or unattended recovery.

v2.name: V2 readiness
v2.status: New worker exam exposed weak mainline owner-facing answers; R33 merged improvements remain unproven live.

Draft #1159/#1169 scored around 7.0-7.1/10 held-out with safety improvements but remain open and flags off, so receive no implementation credit. R33 adds guided worker setup, Maya mail drafts and notifications in merged code, but no production repeated all-five outcomes, verified reliable provider paths or unattended recovery.

v3.name: V3 / Full 10/10 vision
v3.status: Merged worker/UX improvements offset by direct evidence of weak mainline answer quality; core SaaS, custom-agent and economic proof still absent.
v3.summary: Nov 19: developer-facing R33 mainline merged #1164, yet release gate 44509037106 failed at Plan, tests/deploy skipped. Mainline 5-worker held-out/exam evidence #1152 reveals 3.6/10 answer quality; unmerged smart-worker #1159/#1169 scores ~7.0/10 do not count toward implemented capability. Unmerged designer Stromation #359 and skill #57 have simulated/fixture validation but no real accepted premium build. No full SaaS, automated custom agent, 95–99% routine workflow denominator, accepted economics or measured founder-only hours.
